definitions.explanation: The area or direction in front of something or someone. A somewhat formal word for the space ahead.

examples.japanese: {前方|ぜんぽう}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
{前方|ぜんぽう}に{大|おお}きな{橋|はし}が{見|み}えてきた。
examples.english: A large bridge came into view ahead.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{前方|ぜんぽう}に{子|こ}どもが{飛|と}び{出|だ}してきたので、{急|きゅう}ブレーキをかけた。
examples.english: A child jumped out in front of the car, so I slammed on the brakes.

notes:
{前方|ぜんぽう} is a formal word for 'ahead' or 'in front.' More formal than {前|まえ}, and commonly used in driving, announcements, and written instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前方|ぜんぽう}{不注意|ふちゅうい}: failure to watch ahead (common traffic violation)
- {前方|ぜんぽう}{確認|かくにん}: forward check (driving safety)
- {前方|ぜんぽう}に{注意|ちゅうい}: watch ahead
- {前方|ぜんぽう}{後方|こうほう}: front and back

DIRECTION SET:
- {前方|ぜんぽう}: front, ahead
- {後方|こうほう}: rear, behind
- {左方|さほう}: left side
- {右方|うほう}: right side

CONTRAST WITH {前|まえ}:
{前|まえ} is everyday and casual. {前方|ぜんぽう} is formal and often technical — used in traffic reports, announcements, and official instructions.
